customer_concentration.grouping_method: Revenue aggregated to economic customer using COALESCE(parent_customer_id, customer_id); only one parent relationship exists in source data, so most customers remain standalone.

retention.methodology: Starting cohort defined as economic customers with positive ARR on 2024-12-01. NRR uses ending ARR at 2025-12-01 for the starting cohort divided by starting ARR. GRR uses LEAST(start_arr, end_arr) aggregated across the same cohort, which excludes expansion benefit. Logo churn counts starting-cohort customers with at least one zero-ARR month during FY2025 as gross churn events; reactivations are preserved in ARR bridge separately and do not erase churn events.

recurring_revenue.methodology: Management-tagged recurring revenue uses recorded revenue_type tags containing recurring or subscription semantics. Independent restatement requires product evidence indicating subscription economics through delivery_model or product_family plus non-null service period start and end. Amounts not supported by either rule remain ambiguous rather than forced into recurring/non-recurring classification.

collections_quality.weighted_collection_days_methodology: Invoice-value-weighted average of DATEDIFF(payment_date, invoice_date) for paid invoices. Traditional period-end DSO not supported because no period-end accounts receivable balance or due-date/outstanding-balance table was available.

customer_tenure.population: Top 10 FY2025 economic customers by revenue

claim_comparisons.claim_text: No single customer accounts for more than 10% of revenue.
Net revenue retention of 118% demonstrates best-in-class expansion.
94% of revenue is recurring subscription revenue.
Logo churn has remained below 5% annually.
Days sales outstanding is stable at approximately 45 days.
Revenue grew at a 14% CAGR over FY2023-FY2025.
Top 10 customers have an average tenure of 6 years.

metric_evidence.query: WITH rev AS ( SELECT YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) AS fiscal_year, SUM(l.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line l ON i.invoice_id = l.invoice_id GROUP BY YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) ) SELECT CONCAT('FY', CAST(fiscal_year AS STRING)) AS period, total_revenue, line_count FROM rev ORDER BY fiscal_year
metric_evidence.methodology: Revenue calculated at invoice-line grain by joining invoice header to invoice lines and summing line_amount_usd by invoice year to avoid header/line double counting.

metric_evidence.query: WITH yearly AS ( SELECT YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) AS fiscal_year, SUM(l.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line l ON i.invoice_id = l.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) IN (2023, 2025) GROUP BY YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) ), pivoted AS ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2023 THEN total_revenue END) AS start_revenue, MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2025 THEN total_revenue END) AS end_revenue FROM yearly ) SELECT 'FY2023-FY2025' AS period, start_revenue, end_revenue, 2.0 AS num_years, POWER(end_revenue / start_revenue, 1.0 / 2.0) - 1.0 AS revenue_cagr_pct FROM pivoted
metric_evidence.methodology: CAGR calculated fully in SQL using FY2023 revenue as start value, FY2025 revenue as end value, and two annual intervals.

metric_evidence.query: WITH cust_rev AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) AS econ_customer_id, SUM(l.line_amount_usd) AS revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line l ON i.invoice_id = l.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) ), ranked AS ( SELECT revenue, SUM(revenue) OVER() AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rn FROM cust_rev ) SELECT 'FY2025' AS period, MAX(total_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 1 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) / MAX(total_revenue) AS top_1_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 3 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) / MAX(total_revenue) AS top_3_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 5 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) / MAX(total_revenue) AS top_5_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 10 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) / MAX(total_revenue) AS top_10_pct FROM ranked
metric_evidence.methodology: FY2025 invoice-line revenue aggregated by economic customer using parent roll-up where available, ranked in SQL, and concentration percentages computed in SQL against total FY2025 revenue.

metric_evidence.query: WITH cust_rev AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) AS econ_customer_id, MAX(c.customer_name) AS customer_name, SUM(l.line_amount_usd) AS revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line l ON i.invoice_id = l.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) ), ranked AS ( SELECT econ_customer_id, customer_name, revenue, SUM(revenue) OVER() AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY revenue DESC, econ_customer_id) AS rn FROM cust_rev ) SELECT econ_customer_id, customer_name, revenue, total_revenue, rn FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 10 ORDER BY rn
metric_evidence.methodology: Supporting evidence listing top 10 FY2025 economic customers by revenue used in concentration and tenure analysis.

metric_evidence.query: WITH monthly AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, s.customer_id) AS econ_customer_id, CAST(s.snapshot_month AS DATE) AS snapshot_month, SUM(s.arr_usd) AS arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month s LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, s.customer_id), CAST(s.snapshot_month AS DATE) ), hist AS ( SELECT econ_customer_id, snapshot_month, arr_usd, LAG(arr_usd, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY econ_customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS prev_arr, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN arr_usd > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY econ_customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0) AS had_positive_before FROM monthly ), movements AS ( SELECT econ_customer_id, snapshot_month, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month)=2025 AND prev_arr = 0 AND arr_usd > 0 AND had_positive_before=0 THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS new_logo_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month)=2025 AND prev_arr > 0 AND arr_usd > prev_arr THEN arr_usd - prev_arr ELSE 0 END AS expansion_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month)=2025 AND prev_arr > arr_usd AND arr_usd > 0 THEN prev_arr - arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS contraction_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month)=2025 AND prev_arr > 0 AND arr_usd = 0 THEN prev_arr ELSE 0 END AS churned_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month)=2025 AND prev_arr = 0 AND arr_usd > 0 AND had_positive_before=1 THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS reactivation_arr FROM hist ), endpoints AS ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE('2024-12-01') THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END) AS beginning_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE('2025-12-01') THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END) AS ending_arr FROM monthly ) SELECT 'FY2025' AS period, beginning_arr, SUM(new_logo_arr) AS new_logo_arr, SUM(expansion_arr) AS expansion_arr, SUM(contraction_arr) AS contraction_arr, SUM(churned_arr) AS churned_arr, SUM(reactivation_arr) AS reactivation_arr, ending_arr, beginning_arr + SUM(new_logo_arr) + SUM(expansion_arr) - SUM(contraction_arr) - SUM(churned_arr) + SUM(reactivation_arr) AS reconciled_ending_arr, ending_arr - (beginning_arr + SUM(new_logo_arr) + SUM(expansion_arr) - SUM(contraction_arr) - SUM(churned_arr) + SUM(reactivation_arr)) AS reconciliation_diff FROM movements CROSS JOIN endpoints GROUP BY beginning_arr, ending_arr
metric_evidence.methodology: Monthly ARR history aggregated to economic customer and compared month-over-month using SQL window functions. New logos separated from reactivations using prior positive ARR history. Bridge reconciliation tested in SQL against 2024-12 to 2025-12 endpoints.

metric_evidence.query: WITH monthly AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, s.customer_id) AS econ_customer_id, CAST(s.snapshot_month AS DATE) AS snapshot_month, SUM(s.arr_usd) AS arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month s LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, s.customer_id), CAST(s.snapshot_month AS DATE) ), start_cohort AS ( SELECT econ_customer_id, arr_usd AS start_arr FROM monthly WHERE snapshot_month = DATE('2024-12-01') AND arr_usd > 0 ), period_months AS ( SELECT m.econ_customer_id, m.snapshot_month, m.arr_usd, sc.start_arr FROM monthly m JOIN start_cohort sc ON m.econ_customer_id = sc.econ_customer_id WHERE m.snapshot_month BETWEEN DATE('2025-01-01') AND DATE('2025-12-01') ), end_arr AS ( SELECT econ_customer_id, MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE('2025-12-01') THEN arr_usd END) AS end_arr FROM monthly GROUP BY econ_customer_id ), stats AS ( SELECT sc.econ_customer_id, sc.start_arr, COALESCE(e.end_arr,0) AS end_arr, MIN(CASE WHEN pm.arr_usd = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY sc.econ_customer_id) AS any_zero_flag FROM start_cohort sc LEFT JOIN period_months pm ON sc.econ_customer_id = pm.econ_customer_id LEFT JOIN end_arr e ON sc.econ_customer_id = e.econ_customer_id ) SELECT 'FY2025' AS period, COUNT(DISTINCT econ_customer_id) AS starting_logo_count, SUM(DISTINCT start_arr) AS starting_arr, SUM(DISTINCT end_arr) AS ending_arr_from_starting_cohort, SUM(DISTINCT LEAST(start_arr, end_arr)) AS retained_arr_before_expansion, SUM(DISTINCT end_arr) / SUM(DISTINCT start_arr) AS nrr_pct, SUM(DISTINCT LEAST(start_arr, end_arr)) / SUM(DISTINCT start_arr) AS grr_pct, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN any_zero_flag = 1 THEN econ_customer_id END) AS churned_logo_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN any_zero_flag = 1 THEN econ_customer_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT econ_customer_id) AS logo_churn_pct FROM stats
metric_evidence.methodology: Retention cohort defined from 2024-12 positive ARR customers. NRR and GRR calculated in SQL for that cohort. Gross logo churn counts customers with at least one zero-ARR month during FY2025, preserving intra-period churn even if reactivated later.

metric_evidence.query: WITH fy2025 AS ( SELECT i.invoice_id, i.customer_id, YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) AS fiscal_year, l.line_amount_usd, l.revenue_type, l.service_period_start, l.service_period_end, p.delivery_model, p.product_family FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line l ON i.invoice_id = l.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product p ON l.product_id = p.product_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 ) SELECT 'FY2025' AS period, SUM(line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS management_tagged_recurring_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(line_amount_usd) AS management_tagged_recurring_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscription%') AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS restated_recurring_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscription%') AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(line_amount_usd) AS restated_recurring_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscription%') AND NOT ((LOWER(COALESCE(delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscription%') AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL) THEN line_amount_usd WHEN NOT (LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscription%') AND ((LOWER(COALESCE(delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscription%') AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL) THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS reclassified_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ((LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscription%')) AND NOT ((LOWER(COALESCE(delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscription%') AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL) THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS ambiguous_revenue FROM fy2025
metric_evidence.methodology: Two recurring revenue views calculated in SQL: management-tagged recurring based on recorded classification tags, and independent restatement requiring structured subscription product attributes plus valid service periods.

metric_evidence.query: WITH paid AS ( SELECT i.invoice_id, CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE) AS invoice_date, CAST(fc.payment_date AS DATE) AS payment_date, i.invoice_amount_usd, fc.amount_paid_usd, DATEDIFF(CAST(fc.payment_date AS DATE), CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) AS calc_collection_days FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON fc.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE fc.payment_date IS NOT NULL AND i.invoice_amount_usd IS NOT NULL ), weighted AS ( SELECT SUM(invoice_amount_usd * calc_collection_days) / SUM(invoice_amount_usd) AS weighted_collection_days FROM paid ), unpaid AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.invoice_id) AS unpaid_invoice_count, SUM(i.invoice_amount_usd) AS unpaid_invoice_amount FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON i.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id AND fc.payment_date IS NOT NULL WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 AND fc.invoice_id IS NULL ), aging AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(DATE('2025-12-31'), CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) <= 30 THEN '0-30' WHEN DATEDIFF(DATE('2025-12-31'), CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) <= 60 THEN '31-60' WHEN DATEDIFF(DATE('2025-12-31'), CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) <= 90 THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END AS aging_bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT i.invoice_id) AS invoice_count, SUM(i.invoice_amount_usd) AS invoice_amount FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON i.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id AND fc.payment_date IS NOT NULL WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 AND fc.invoice_id IS NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(DATE('2025-12-31'), CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) <= 30 THEN '0-30' WHEN DATEDIFF(DATE('2025-12-31'), CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) <= 60 THEN '31-60' WHEN DATEDIFF(DATE('2025-12-31'), CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) <= 90 THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END ) SELECT 'FY2025' AS period, NULL AS dso_days, weighted.weighted_collection_days, unpaid.unpaid_invoice_amount, unpaid.unpaid_invoice_count, aging.aging_bucket, aging.invoice_count, aging.invoice_amount FROM weighted CROSS JOIN unpaid LEFT JOIN aging ON 1=1 ORDER BY aging.aging_bucket
metric_evidence.methodology: Traditional DSO not calculated because available data supports payment-timing analysis but not period-end AR balance methodology. SQL computes invoice-value-weighted collection days for paid invoices and separately reports unpaid invoice exposure and aging buckets at 2025-12-31.

metric_evidence.query: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) AS econ_customer_id, MAX(c.customer_name) AS customer_name, MIN(CAST(c.first_order_date AS DATE)) AS first_order_date, SUM(l.line_amount_usd) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.line_amount_usd) DESC, COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id)) AS rn FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line l ON i.invoice_id = l.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) ), top10 AS ( SELECT econ_customer_id, customer_name, first_order_date, revenue, months_between(DATE('2025-12-31'), first_order_date) / 12.0 AS tenure_years FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 10 ) SELECT 'FY2025' AS period, COUNT(*) AS top_customer_count, AVG(tenure_years) AS average_tenure_years FROM top10
metric_evidence.methodology: Top 10 FY2025 economic customers ranked by invoice-line revenue in SQL; tenure measured from first_order_date to 2025-12-31 and averaged in SQL.
